ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR share counts and per-share figures are per ordinary share while the Nasdaq/NYSE price ($21.20) is per ADS; per-share OE must be scaled x5 to be comparable to the ADS price, and the market cap is price x ordinary shares / 5
ads_ratio.source: Rentokil Initial plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-25), American Depositary Shares section: 'Each Rentokil Initial ADS will represent five Rentokil Initial ordinary shares' under the Amended and Restated Deposit Agreement dated 26 November 2018; the same 1:5 ADS-to-share ratio is stated in the Terminix combination announcement (128.66 million ADSs = 643.29 million shares)

moat_against: ROIC proxy collapsed post-Terminix (21.0% FY2020 to 5.0% FY2025) and is still falling — scale bought, returns not yet earned
Rollins out-executes in North America (~22.4% margins vs Rentokil ~15.5% group adjusted); local/regional rivals and PE-backed consolidators are taking share
Low switching costs in residential pest control; technician labour churn is structural
Terminix integration ran years late and the North America >20% margin target for 2027 was withdrawn — execution credibility is impaired
Leverage from the deal: net debt $3,575m at H1 2026 (2.4x EBITDA), only just back inside the 2.0-2.5x target range
moat_for: Global #1 pest-control scale: route density and national-account coverage in 80+ countries
Recurring contracted service revenue (route-based, repeat-visit model) with pricing power through the cycle
Rentokil + Terminix brand pair in North America, the world's largest pest-control market
H1 2026 proof the franchise still grows: organic revenue +3.6%, adjusted operating profit +6.6%, FCF conversion 96%
moat_justification: Global #1 in pest control with route density, recurring contracted revenue and the Rentokil/Terminix brands, but the moat is narrow in practice: fundamentals.json roic_proxy fell from 21.0% (FY2020) and 12.2% (FY2021) to 3.2% in the Terminix deal year and has kept falling since (6.5% / 5.5% / 5.0% FY2023-25) — the acquired scale has not yet earned its cost of capital, Rollins runs ~22.4% North America margins against Rentokil's ~15.5% group adjusted margin, residential switching costs are low and local competitors keep taking share. Gross margin is not presented in the IFRS filings (fundamentals.json gross_margin is null for every year), so the ROIC series is the margin evidence.
name: Rentokil Initial plc
one_liner: Quality route-based franchise with a narrow moat (5/10) whose returns were diluted by the Terminix deal — per-ADS weighted IRR 9.1% (bear 7.6% / bull 10.5%) and IV@15% $11.11 vs the $21.20 ADS price, so it clears 15% only below ~$11.11.
